subject.title: Show claude-swap accounts in CLI cards

question: Should enabling claude-swap for the app also opt `codexbar cards` into automatically replacing ambient Claude cards whenever two or more accounts are reported?
rationale: Current main defines claude-swap behavior for the menu-bar app but not automatic CLI replacement; extending the same setting into a new command-output contract requires explicit product intent.

options.title: Approve CLI parity
options.body: Allow two-or-more-account lists to replace ambient CLI cards while preserving explicit account and source overrides.

options.title: Require explicit CLI opt-in
options.body: Add a separate flag or setting so existing claude-swap users retain current CLI output until they choose multi-account cards.

options.title: Keep integration app-only
options.body: Leave `codexbar cards` unchanged and continue exposing claude-swap multi-account behavior only in the menu-bar app.

recommendation.title: Approve CLI parity
recommendation.body: Allow two-or-more-account lists to replace ambient CLI cards while preserving explicit account and source overrides.

likelyOwner.reason: The contributor directly requested this repository owner's contract decision, and recent history ties this person to the affected CLI cards behavior.
